info.name: Vehicle Accessory Management System
info.description:
End-to-end API suite. Select the **VAMS Local** environment, start the backend, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (folders run top to bottom). Tokens and ids are captured automatically into collection variables.

Auth: the collection uses `Bearer {{adminToken}}` by default; customer and public requests override it.

exec: // Runs after EVERY request in the collection.
pm.test('Error body has the standard shape', () => {

item.name: 00 Demo (seeded data)
item.description: Presentation walkthrough. Needs the dev profile with DEMO_SEED=true on an empty database (see README). Set demoCustomerPassword in the environment to the DEMO_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD from backend/.env. Run this folder on its own; the numbered folders below create their own data and conflict with seeded vehicle numbers.

item.name: My garage: two vehicles, primary first

exec: pm.test('Exactly one primary, listed first', () => { pm.expect(garage[0].primary).to.be.true; pm.expect(garage.filter(v => v.primary).length).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Accessories for my primary vehicle (no cost price shown)

exec: const byName = n => body.compatibleAccessories.find(a => a.name === n);
pm.test('Cost price is hidden from customers', () => body.compatibleAccessories.forEach(a => pm.expect(a).to.not.have.property('costPrice')));

item.name: Model search: every Swift and what fits it

exec: pm.test('Bulk tyre deal at 4 tyres', () => pm.expect(q.lines[1].appliedDiscount.name).to.eql('Buy 4 tyres, save 15%'));

item.name: Quote: FESTIVE25 coupon beats them (best single discount, capped)
Quote: expired coupon is rejected with a clear message (422)

exec: pm.test('Roof rack flagged as not compatible with the Swift', () => pm.expect(q.lines[0].warnings.join()).to.include('Not listed as compatible'));
pm.test('Mud flaps flagged out of stock', () => pm.expect(q.lines[1].warnings).to.include('Out of stock'));

item.name: Customer cannot use the admin API (403)
Admin: inventory report (low stock, reorder, fast movers)

exec: pm.test('Mud flaps out of stock', () => pm.expect(r.outOfStockItems.map(i => i.name)).to.include('Mud Flaps'));
pm.test('Roof rack low on stock', () => pm.expect(r.lowStockItems.map(i => i.name)).to.include('Roof Rack'));
pm.test('Phone mount is a fast mover', () => pm.expect(r.fastMovingProducts.map(i => i.name)).to.include('Magnetic Phone Mount'));

item.name: Admin: price history of the mats

exec: const deal = pm.response.json().content.find(d => d.name === 'Buy 4 tyres, save 15%');
pm.test('Discounts expose a version for safe editing', () => pm.expect(deal.version).to.be.a('number'));
// The full PUT body with the version we just read. Extending the end date is a real change (an identical
// save is a no-op and keeps the version) that leaves every price unchanged.
const body = (({name, code, type, value, scope, category, accessoryId, maxDiscountAmount, minQuantity, validFrom, validTo, active, version}) =>
({name, code, type, value, scope, category, accessoryId, maxDiscountAmount, minQuantity, validFrom, validTo, active, version}))(deal);

item.name: Admin: extend the tyre deal using the version just read (200)
Admin: a second save with the now-stale version is rejected (409)

exec: pm.test('Says reload and try again', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Reload and try again'));

item.name: Refresh: the rotated-out token cannot be reused (401)
01 Auth
item.description: Register a customer and log in as admin and customer.

request.description: 201 on first run; 409 on later runs (email already registered). Both are fine.

exec: pm.test('Fields saved', () => { pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('All-Weather Floor Mats'); pm.expect(body.price).to.eql(1499); });
pm.test('Error message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Accessory with id 999999 not found"));

  "name": "All-Weather Floor Mats",

item.name: 03 Admin - Vehicles
item.description: Vehicle CRUD (ADMIN only). Vehicle numbers are unique, trimmed and upper-cased.

exec: pm.test('Model and year updated', () => { pm.expect(body.model).to.eql('Swift ZXi'); pm.expect(body.year).to.eql(2023); });

item.name: 04 Admin - Mappings
item.description: Map accessories to a vehicle (ADMIN only).

exec: pm.test('Error message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Accessories not found with ids [999999]"));

item.name: 05 Compatibility
item.description: Accessory search by vehicle number (ADMIN or CUSTOMER). Case and surrounding spaces are ignored.

exec: pm.test('Sorted by category then name', () => pm.expect(body.compatibleAccessories.map(a => a.category)).to.eql(['Exterior', 'Interior']));
pm.test('Error message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Vehicle with number 'ZZ00ZZ0000' not found"));

item.name: 06 Admin - Users
item.description: List users and change roles (ADMIN only).

item.name: Promoted user can use admin API

request.description: The role is re-read on every request, so the existing token picks up the new role immediately.

item.name: 07 Cleanup
item.description: Deletes the test vehicle. Accessories with stock history are kept on purpose (audit trail), so this run leaves its two accessories behind; run against a scratch database.

item.name: Delete accessory with stock history is refused (422)

exec: pm.test('Explains the stock history rule', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('stock movement'));

item.name: 08 Logout
item.description: Logout revokes the given refresh token; no access token is needed. Access tokens are short-lived and keep working until they expire (30 minutes by default).

item.name: Logged-out refresh token cannot be used (401)
Access token still works until it expires (by design)
